skill.name: postmark-automation
skill.description: Use Rube MCP to manage Postmark templates, batch sends, delivery stats, bounces, complaints, and server settings.
skill.summary: Automate common Postmark email operations through Rube MCP with schema lookup first.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around MCP tool names and parameters. The skill has real network and account-impacting capabilities because it can send Postmark emails and change server, template, and SMTP settings through Rube MCP. No prompt injection text or malicious exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Batch email sends can reach many recipients.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit human approval, recipient review, and template validation before calling batch send tools.

remediation.issue: Postmark server edits can change SMTP API and webhook behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Treat server edits as high-risk and require approval, change notes, and allowed webhook domains.

remediation.issue: Template edits replace stored template content.
remediation.suggestion: Fetch the current template, present a diff-style summary, and validate rendering before saving edits.

remediation.issue: The skill depends on an external Rube MCP endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Document the third-party MCP dependency and advise users to review data access before connecting Postmark.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Postmark connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `postmark`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
1. `POSTMARK_LIST_TEMPLATES` - Find available templates and their IDs [Prerequisite]
2. `POSTMARK_VALIDATE_TEMPLATE` - Validate template with model data before sending [Optional]
3. `POSTMARK_SEND_BATCH_WITH_TEMPLATES` - Send batch emails using a template [Required]
- `TemplateId` or `TemplateAlias`: Identifier for the template to use
- Either `TemplateId` or `TemplateAlias` is required, not both
- `TemplateModel` keys must match template variable names exactly (case-sensitive)
1. `POSTMARK_LIST_TEMPLATES` - List all templates with IDs and names [Required]
2. `POSTMARK_GET_TEMPLATE` - Get full template details including HTML/text body [Optional]
4. `POSTMARK_VALIDATE_TEMPLATE` - Test template rendering with sample data [Optional]
- `TemplateId`: Numeric template ID for GET/EDIT operations
3. `POSTMARK_GET_TRACKED_EMAIL_COUNTS` - Get tracked email volume over time [Optional]
- `messagestreamid` defaults to all streams if not specified
- `count`: Number of records to return per page
- Pagination uses `count` and `offset`, not page tokens
- `InboundHookUrl`: Webhook URL for inbound email processing
- Changing `SmtpApiActivated` affects SMTP relay access immediately
- Set `count` for results per page (varies by endpoint)
- Use `offset` to skip previously fetched results
- Response data may be nested under `data` or `data.data`
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Changing `SmtpApiActivated` affects SMTP relay access immediately

semantic_findings.title: Batch Email Sending Capability
semantic_findings.description: The skill guides POSTMARK_SEND_BATCH_WITH_TEMPLATES for multiple recipients and notes a 500 message batch limit. This can send account email at scale if approved without review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly covers templated batch sending and recipient-related constraints. The capability is legitimate, but it can cause unauthorized outreach or data disclosure.

semantic_findings.title: Sensitive Server Configuration Changes
semantic_findings.description: The skill guides POSTMARK_EDIT_SERVER and lists SMTP API, bounce webhook, inbound webhook, open tracking, and link tracking fields. Unreviewed changes could alter mail flow or redirect event data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented tool sequence includes editing server settings that directly affect SMTP relay and webhook destinations. These settings are high-impact account controls.

semantic_findings.title: Production Email Template Modification
semantic_findings.description: The skill guides POSTMARK_EDIT_TEMPLATE and notes that edits replace template content. Mistaken or malicious edits could change production transactional email subjects, HTML, or text bodies.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The template workflow explicitly supports editing content and warns that edits replace existing fields. This is a meaningful integrity risk for customer-facing email.

content.value_statement: Postmark operations often require repeated tool calls and careful parameter checks. This skill guides email sending, template work, delivery monitoring, and server updates through Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Finds current Postmark tool schemas through RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS before workflow execution.
Guides batch templated email sends with template IDs, aliases, message fields, and model data.
Lists, retrieves, edits, and validates Postmark email templates through Rube MCP tools.
Reviews delivery statistics, outbound overview data, tracked email counts, bounces, and complaints.
Retrieves and edits Postmark server settings, including tracking, SMTP API, and webhook fields.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active authenticated Postmark connection before any workflow can run.
Does not provide direct Postmark API credentials or bypass Postmark account permissions.
Cannot guarantee delivery success, inbox placement, or recipient engagement.
Server, template, and send actions can affect production email if used without review.

use_cases.title: Send Product Notifications
use_cases.description: Prepare a validated templated batch send for customer lifecycle messages or account notices.

use_cases.title: Maintain Transactional Templates
use_cases.description: Inspect, update, and validate Postmark templates before changes reach customer-facing email.

use_cases.title: Review Delivery Health
use_cases.description: Check bounces, spam complaints, outbound activity, and tracked counts for a Postmark server.

prompt_templates.title: Check Connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm Rube MCP can access Postmark. Search available Postmark tools, check the connection status, and tell me what setup step is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Template Send
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a controlled templated email test
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Postmark template named {template_name}. Inspect its required variables, validate it with sample data, and summarize any missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Review Delivery Issues
prompt_templates.scenario: Investigate delivery health over a date range
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Postmark delivery stats, outbound overview, bounces, and spam complaints from {start_date} to {end_date}. Highlight the main risks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Server Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the current Postmark server settings. Propose changes for tracking and webhook fields, but do not edit anything until I approve.

output_examples.input: Review delivery health for last week.
output_examples.output: Summary includes sent volume, opened and clicked counts, bounce totals by type, complaint counts, and recommended follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: Prepare a welcome email batch using an existing template.
output_examples.output: Result includes selected template details, required model fields, validation outcome, recipient limits, and a send-ready approval checklist.

output_examples.input: Update a Postmark template subject and text fallback.
output_examples.output: Response includes current template fields, proposed edits, validation notes, and a warning that edits replace the stored template content.

best_practices: Search for current Rube MCP tool schemas before choosing any Postmark tool.
Validate templates with sample data before every batch send or template edit.
Require human approval for sends, server edits, webhook changes, and SMTP API changes.
anti_patterns: Sending to large recipient lists before validating template variables and sender identity.
Editing server webhook or SMTP settings without documenting the business reason.
Assuming response data has one fixed nesting shape across all Rube MCP tools.

faq.question: Does this skill need a Postmark API key?
faq.answer: It uses an authenticated Postmark connection through Rube MCP. It does not provide or create Postmark credentials.

faq.question: Can it send emails in bulk?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes Postmark templated batch sending and notes the 500 message limit per batch call.

faq.question: Can it edit production templates?
faq.answer: Yes, if the connected Postmark account has permission. Template edits should be reviewed and validated first.

faq.question: Can it monitor bounces and complaints?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides calls for bounce records, spam complaint records, delivery stats, and outbound overview data.

faq.question: Does it automatically choose tool schemas?
faq.answer: No. It instructs the agent to search Rube MCP tools first so current schemas drive each workflow.

faq.question: What actions need extra approval?
faq.answer: Batch sends, template edits, SMTP API changes, tracking changes, and webhook URL changes need explicit approval.
